scope: Proposition 4.3 (Odd lower bound) of the manuscript “The crossing number of complete graphs” (preprints/The-crossing-number-of-complete-graphs-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 165 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8b4c78b04d710b7d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every normalized minimum drawing of K2s+1, s ≥ 2, has at least s 2 2 crossings.
